metadata.note: Representative service-area markers for public flex, demand-response, microtransit, and small local systems without usable route geometry. Markers are not live vehicle positions.

properties.title: Aroostook Regional Transportation System
properties.details: Serves Aroostook County plus Danforth and Patten. Service must often be arranged in advance.

properties.title: Downeast Transportation
properties.details: Serves Hancock and Washington counties and connects smaller Downeast communities.

properties.title: Penquis Transportation
properties.details: Serves Penobscot and Piscataquis counties beyond Bangor's fixed-route network.

properties.title: KVCAP Transportation
properties.details: Public and coordinated transportation in rural central Maine; many trips require advance booking.

properties.title: Mid-Coast Connector
properties.details: Connects communities in Waldo, Knox, Lincoln, and Sagadahoc counties and the Brunswick area.

properties.title: York County Community Action transportation
properties.details: Serves York County and several southern Oxford County towns.

properties.title: The LAP
properties.details: Seven-day public commuter service with stops in Lewiston, Auburn, and Portland. This marker represents the service, not a live bus.

properties.title: Concord Area Transit
properties.details: Public transportation within Concord. No current reliable open GTFS route geometry was available in the audit.

properties.title: Tri-County Transit · Berlin–Gorham
properties.details: A scheduled loop that can deviate up to one quarter mile with advance notice.

properties.title: Tri-County Transit · Tri-Town
properties.details: Public flex route serving three North Country towns; deviations require advance notice.

properties.title: Sullivan County Transportation
properties.status: Charlestown, Claremont, Newport, and Lebanon service
properties.details: Open-to-everyone shared rides, scheduled buses, route deviations, Claremont Dial-A-Ride, and a countywide volunteer-driver program.

properties.title: Belknap–Merrimack community transportation
properties.status: Accessible community rides beyond fixed routes
properties.details: Community Action Program transportation centered on Belknap and Merrimack counties; eligibility and advance-booking rules vary by program.

properties.title: Souhegan Valley transportation
properties.status: Community rides in the Milford / Souhegan Valley area
properties.details: A locally coordinated ride option for communities not covered well by fixed-route buses; reservations and eligibility vary.

properties.title: Transport Central
properties.status: Community transportation in central New Hampshire
properties.details: Plymouth-area accessible transportation listed in New Hampshire's statewide community-provider directory.

properties.title: Lexpress
properties.details: Small municipal fixed-route service. Scheduled route geometry is also included from its official GTFS feed.

properties.title: Middlesex 3 TMA shuttles
properties.details: Scheduled mobility serving Bedford and the Middlesex 3 corridor; route geometry is included where published in GTFS.

properties.title: GATRA GO / microtransit
properties.details: GATRA operates app/phone-booked zones across several southeastern Massachusetts communities; routes vary by request.

properties.title: SmartDART
properties.details: App/phone-booked microtransit; no fixed path should be drawn because each trip is requested dynamically.

properties.title: Via WRTA
properties.details: Microtransit complements WRTA fixed routes; vehicle paths depend on rider requests.

properties.title: CATA On Demand
properties.status: Public microtransit in Gloucester and Rockport
properties.details: Weekday app-booked minibus trips complement Cape Ann's published fixed-route network.

properties.title: CATCH Connect
properties.details: Fare-free on-demand rides within Wellesley with links to Newton-Wellesley Hospital, Natick, and MBTA connections.

properties.title: FRTA Access
properties.status: On-demand public rides across rural western Massachusetts
properties.details: Self-scheduled public transportation covers service zones in Franklin County and portions of Hampshire and Hampden counties.

properties.title: CrossTown Connect · Acton
properties.details: Cross-Acton Transit links housing, business centers, Town Hall, and South Acton station; MinuteVan and other booked rides fill local gaps.

properties.title: Northeastern Connecticut Transit District
properties.details: Serves Brooklyn, Canterbury, Eastford, Hampton, Killingly, Plainfield, Pomfret, Putnam, Thompson, Union, and Woodstock.

properties.title: Northwestern Connecticut Transit District
properties.details: Serves Torrington, Winsted, and rural northwest Connecticut communities.

properties.title: VTD2GO
properties.status: Evening microtransit in Ansonia, Derby, and Shelton
properties.details: App/phone-booked public rides connect to Metro-North, CTtransit, and Greater Bridgeport Transit.

properties.title: GHTD Link
properties.status: On-demand transit in Enfield and East Windsor
properties.details: Point-to-point booked rides connect the two-town zone with CTtransit route 905.

properties.title: HOP and New London Smart Ride
properties.status: Microtransit in Groton, Mystic/Noank, Stonington, Waterford, and New London
properties.details: Same-day public rides cover several separate southeastern Connecticut zones and connect with buses, rail, Amtrak, and Cross Sound Ferry.

properties.title: Milford Micro
properties.status: Evening and weekend on-demand public rides
properties.details: Serves downtown Milford, the mall, beaches, medical and shopping destinations, and the Metro-North station.

properties.title: Via NHV
properties.details: On-demand public rides fill neighborhood gaps and connect Union and State Street rail stations.

properties.title: XtraMile
properties.status: Microtransit in Middletown, East Hampton, Madison, and Guilford
properties.details: Separate on-demand zones connect rural and shoreline communities to River Valley Transit, CTtransit, Shore Line East, Amtrak, and the Air Line Trail.

properties.title: GBT Connect
properties.details: Public rides connect neighborhoods, jobs, shopping, and civic destinations to Greater Bridgeport Transit routes.

properties.title: Wheels2U
properties.details: An on-demand public connection for trips that do not fit the fixed-route network.

properties.title: StamFORWARD
properties.details: Microtransit serves a designated city zone and complements local bus and Metro-North connections.

properties.title: RIPTA South County Flex
properties.status: Flexible transit in URI, Narragansett, South Kingstown, and Westerly
properties.details: Scheduled stops plus reserved pickup/drop-off within designated zones connect smaller communities to RIPTA's statewide network.

properties.title: RIPTA northern Flex zones
properties.status: Flexible transit around Woonsocket, Manville, Pascoag, and Slatersville
properties.details: Flex vehicles serve lower-density communities by scheduled stop or advance reservation within each zone.

properties.title: RIPTA West Bay / Aquidneck Flex
properties.status: Flexible transit in West Warwick, Coventry, and South Aquidneck
properties.details: Community-scale flexible service links riders with the larger RIPTA bus network.

properties.title: Rhode Island community transportation directory
properties.status: Town shuttles, volunteer drivers, and local resources
properties.details: RIPTA maintains town-by-town pages for local and specialized transportation beyond the statewide fixed-route network.

properties.title: SSTA demand-response mobility
properties.status: Booked public and specialized rides in Chittenden County
properties.details: Complements Green Mountain Transit's Burlington-area fixed routes; individual trips do not follow a fixed public path.

properties.title: RCT demand-response mobility
properties.status: Rural rides across Vermont's Northeast Kingdom
properties.details: Rural Community Transportation provides regional fixed and booked services in northeastern Vermont communities.

properties.title: Tri-Valley Transit demand-response
properties.status: Booked rides in Addison, Orange, northern Windsor, and Washington regions
properties.details: Town-level transportation fills gaps beyond Tri-Valley Transit's published fixed routes.

properties.title: GMCN demand-response mobility
properties.details: Green Mountain Community Network provides booked and fixed services centered on Bennington County communities.

properties.title: Marble Valley demand-response
properties.details: Complements The Bus fixed routes across Rutland and nearby rural towns.

properties.title: MOOver demand-response mobility
properties.status: Booked rides across Windham and southern Windsor counties
properties.details: Complements published MOOver routes in southeastern Vermont and the Deerfield Valley.

properties.title: Cranberry Isles Commuter Ferry
properties.details: The official GTFS catalog currently exposes the service but not usable route geometry, so Motion shows a service marker instead of inventing a water path.
